raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: crcmod
  version: "1.7"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/crcmod-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: dc7051a0db5f2bd48665a990d3ec1cc305a466a77358ca4492826f41f283601e

build:
  number: 1014
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: 
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
  host:
    - pip
    - python
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - crcmod
        - crcmod._crcfunext
      pip_check: false

about:
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: CRC Generator
  description: |
    Python module for generating objects that compute the Cyclic Redundancy
    Check (CRC)
  homepage: http://crcmod.sourceforge.net

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - bgruening
    - chapmanb
    - xylar
    - nehaljwani
